title: commission
description:
Add a new device to the transport — pair, join, adopt.

Commissioning is slow and multi-stage, so the plugin should report progress as `commissioning.<sessionId>.progress` pushes while this call is outstanding rather than leaving the user watching a spinner. The core supplies `sessionId` so it can correlate the two before the result arrives.

sessionId.description: Topic scope for progress pushes. Absent means the caller does not want progress.

payload.description: Setup code or QR payload, e.g. a Matter `MT:...` string. Absent for transports where pairing is a permit-join mode rather than a per-device operation.

target.description: A `ref` from discoverCommissionable, to pair one specific advertised device rather than whatever answers first.

network.title: Network credentials
network.description: For transports that must hand the device a network to join — Matter Wi-Fi and Thread commissioning. Kept as an open object rather than typed fields because each transport wants different keys, and this is the one place where a wrong guess would force a v2.

device.description: The interviewed device, if the plugin has it to hand. Saves the core a follow-up `discover`.
